title: Gate a command behind a technology-set license
summary: Shows how an extension checks IServerSecurity.IsTechnologySetSupported on its own server module before running a command, with a filtered PCB board iterator that counts pads as the gated work.
phrasings: check if a license feature is available before running a command
only allow an extension command when licensed
get IServerSecurity from my extension's server module

commands.name: CountPads
commands.description: Count the pads of the current board if a technology set is licensed
commands.params: TechnologySet=<name> (optional, default: the extension's server name, LicensedPadCount); Server=<name> (optional, default LicensedPadCount: the server module that supplies IServerSecurity)

commands.name: CheckLicense
commands.description: Check whether a technology set is licensed (addition)
commands.params: TechnologySet=<name> (optional, default LicensedPadCount); Server=<name> (optional, default LicensedPadCount: the server module that supplies IServerSecurity)
